name: euterpe
description: An AI pair-writing companion — a presence beside you while you write.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Euterpe's mind is an AI agent that reads the folder's files, and can write files and run commands without asking. In Restricted Mode, its settings, personas and mascots are there, but a writing session waits until you trust the folder.

euterpe.persona.markdownDescription: Who Euterpe is: `cheeky`, `warm`, `editor`, `coach`, `drill-sergeant`, `fan`, or one of your own (a Markdown file in the `personas` folder of Euterpe's home). [Choose a persona](command:euterpe.choosePersona), or read them all in [Euterpe's settings](command:euterpe.openSettings?%5B%22persona%22%5D). Takes effect at the next session.

euterpe.mascot.markdownDescription: The body Euterpe wears on screen: `clawd`, `boo`, `mochi`, `inky`, `clippy`, or one of your own (a mascot file in the `mascots` folder of Euterpe's home). [Choose a mascot](command:euterpe.chooseMascot), or watch them all move in [Euterpe's settings](command:euterpe.openSettings?%5B%22mascot%22%5D). Changes at once during a session.

euterpe.avatarScale.markdownDescription: How big Euterpe is on screen: each pixel of its art becomes N × N pixels. Takes effect at the next session.

enumDescriptions: Claude, through Claude Code, on your Claude login (a subscription or an API key)
Your ChatGPT plan (sign in with ChatGPT), OpenAI's API, or any OpenAI-compatible one (OpenRouter, a local Ollama or LM Studio…) with your own key
Your GitHub Copilot plan: the models Copilot offers you in VS Code, with no key
euterpe.provider.markdownDescription: What Euterpe's mind runs on: **Claude**, through Claude Code and your Claude login; **OpenAI and others**: your ChatGPT plan ([Sign In with ChatGPT](command:euterpe.signIn)), OpenAI's API, or any OpenAI-compatible one with your own key (`#euterpe.openaiBaseUrl#`, [Set API Key](command:euterpe.setApiKey)); or **GitHub Copilot**: the models your Copilot plan offers in VS Code. Clawd, Claude Code's mascot, only comes with Claude. Takes effect at the next session. [Euterpe's settings](command:euterpe.openSettings?%5B%22mind%22%5D) set it all up.

euterpe.model.markdownDescription: The Claude model Euterpe's mind thinks with on **Claude** (`#euterpe.provider#`): `haiku` (the quickest and cheapest), `sonnet` (the default when empty), `opus` (more thoughtful, and pricier), `fable` (the most thoughtful, and by far the most expensive), each Claude Code's latest of its kind, or any model Claude Code knows (`claude --model`). [Choose a model](command:euterpe.chooseModel): it also switches during a session.

euterpe.openaiModel.markdownDescription: The model Euterpe's mind thinks with on **OpenAI and others** (`#euterpe.provider#`). On your ChatGPT plan: one it offers, like `gpt-5.6-sol` (empty: Euterpe's pick, the plan's Sol rather than its first, the frontier model a plan allows least of). On OpenAI's API: `gpt-6.1-sol` (the default when empty: nearly as thoughtful as Astra, quicker and much cheaper), `gpt-6-astra` (the best writer, at five times the price), `gpt-6-luna` (the quickest and cheapest), or any model the API knows. Elsewhere, the model as your provider names it (`meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct`, `qwen3-coder:30b`…): another provider has no default. [Choose a model](command:euterpe.chooseModel): it also switches during a session.

euterpe.openaiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: The OpenAI-compatible API Euterpe's mind uses with **OpenAI and others** (`#euterpe.provider#`). Empty: your ChatGPT plan, with no key: [Sign In with ChatGPT](command:euterpe.signIn). Else its base URL, like `https://api.openai.com/v1` (OpenAI's API), `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` or `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama), whose API key is kept in VS Code's secret storage, for this address only: [Set API Key](command:euterpe.setApiKey). User settings only: a workspace can't send your key, or your writing, elsewhere.

euterpe.copilotModel.markdownDescription: The model Euterpe's mind thinks with on **GitHub Copilot** (`#euterpe.provider#`): one Copilot offers you in VS Code, by its id. Empty: Euterpe's pick, Copilot's Auto (Copilot chooses the model). [Choose a model](command:euterpe.chooseModel): it also switches during a session.

enumDescriptions: The snappiest replies, and the cheapest looks
euterpe.effort.markdownDescription: How hard Euterpe thinks before each turn (`claude --effort`, the API's reasoning effort, or GitHub Copilot's Effort Level). Lower: snappier chat replies, and cheaper looks. Not every model takes every level: on an API, Euterpe moves to the nearest one it does; on GitHub Copilot, a model that doesn't take it thinks at its own default. Takes effect at the next session.

enumDescriptions: Reads right behind you: a look at every pause, and at least every 15 s while you type. A typo reaches the notes seconds after you make it.
A look when you stop for a few seconds, and at least every minute: roughly a third of the looks, and a shorter memory of the session.
A look at longer pauses, and every few minutes: the fewest, cheapest looks. Notes arrive a paragraph later.
euterpe.attention.markdownDescription: How closely Euterpe reads along. Each look is a short turn on your Claude login (mostly served from the prompt cache), so fewer looks cost less of your usage. Takes effect at the next session.

euterpe.followActiveEditor.description: Follow you to whatever document you switch to (after a couple of seconds there). Off: Euterpe stays with the document the session started on.

euterpe.homeDir.markdownDescription: Euterpe's home folder: its memory, your personas and mascots, and the working directory of its mind. Empty: `~/.euterpe`. Point it at a synced folder to share Euterpe's memory between machines. User settings only.

euterpe.claudeConfigDir.markdownDescription: The Claude Code config folder Euterpe's mind uses (it sets `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`): which login pays for it (a subscription or an API key), its settings and its session history. Empty: whatever VS Code's environment has, usually `~/.claude`. Set it when you keep several Claude Code setups, such as a personal subscription and a work API key. User settings only.

euterpe.claudePath.markdownDescription: The `claude` executable. Empty: found automatically on PATH, then where the native installer, Homebrew, WinGet and npm put it, then inside the Claude Code VS Code extension. User settings only: a workspace can't point it elsewhere.

euterpe.electronPath.markdownDescription: An Electron executable for Euterpe's avatar window, for machines that can't download it (offline, managed). Empty: Euterpe downloads Electron 44 once, into its own storage. User settings only.

euterpe.debugMind.markdownDescription: Debug the mind: an **Euterpe Mind** terminal shows a live, readable transcript (perceptions, replies, tool calls, each turn's cache and token usage; type into it to talk to Euterpe), and the raw stream-json traffic goes to the Euterpe log.
